title: Easter
lyrics_plain:
Hear the bells ringing, they're singing that we can be born again.  Hear the bells ringing, they're singing "Christ is risen from the dead!"  The angel upon the tombstone said "He is risen just as He said.
Quickly now go tell His disciples that Jesus Christ is no longer dead!"
Joy to the world, He is risen, Alleluia!
He's risen, Alleluia! He's risen,
